final: WITH customer_counts AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id), total_calc AS (SELECT SUM(count) AS total_count FROM customer_counts WHERE count IS NOT NULL), avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(count) AS avg_count FROM customer_counts WHERE count IS NOT NULL) SELECT cc.store_id, cc.count, CAST(cc.count AS REAL) / CAST(tc.total_count AS REAL) AS count_div_total, CAST(cc.count AS REAL) / ac.avg_count AS count_div_avg FROM customer_counts cc CROSS JOIN total_calc tc CROSS JOIN avg_calc ac WHERE cc.count IS NOT NULL AND tc.total_count IS NOT NULL AND ac.avg_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cc.store_id
